name: shared-complex-geometry-v2

input: Reviewed329/330 original ordered training records and fixed latent route, bound to complete319 parent and source hashes. No task names, generator rule or original heldout inputs/labels.
features: Ordinal u,v in[-1,1]. Fixed [1,u,v,u*u,u*v,v*v] plus separate positive hinges in u and v at the uniform interior knots of grids16 or32; the third bank is quadratic only. Normalize by max(1,L1 raw row), zero pad to8/64/128, and apply the complete unitary DFT. A separate one-state constant code supplies the fixed common offset192.
decoder: Per block, observed raw labels in first-occurrence order. Refuse more than two labels. A binary block orients its labels by their training centroid projection along one of16 fixed directions; exact ties use first occurrence. Empty blocks have zero logits; singleton blocks have fixed common192 on their observed class. Raw label names are categorical.
sharing: Every binary block uses the same complete complex vector alpha plus its own real intercept beta/sqrt(M) in every real Fourier slot. Its two raw-class columns are opposite signed copies, plus the fixed common offset. All absent classes have zero logits. The complete expanded tensor remains the actual model even though storage and products exploit the fixed sharing map.
budget: Global complete per-class L1 radius1048576. Offset cost T=192*max raw-class block occurrences. Each real/imag alpha coordinate costs max binary raw-class occurrences; beta costs ceil(sqrt(M)). The weighted parameter radius is1048576-T. Initialize by radial shrink if necessary; CE steps use the exact weighted Euclidean L1 projection. Audit expanded column norms independently.
initializer: Retain all v1 group-centered moment constructors, ridges[0.000001,0.0001,0.01],16 directions and gains[2,8,32,128]. Each also gets a calibrated-intercept variant: project fit records through its learned global spatial score and use each binary block's interval midpoint only when its two projected class intervals strictly separate; retain its moment intercept on overlap. Add16 fixed shared linear directions, oriented by training class centroids, with the same interval calibration and balanced class-centroid midpoint on overlap. Ridge0 explicitly marks these direction constructors. Convert spatial coefficients to the complete conjugate DFT. These analytic constructors perform zero CE gradients. Retain every state, gap, candidate score and refusal; the declared library has1344 configurations,1008 fold states and4032 gain scores.
selection: Three deterministic cell-hash folds keep repeated inputs together and exclude all their records from head fitting. Evaluate actual ordinary full-vocabulary CE on each fold; choose minimum pooled fold CE, first bank/ridge/direction/gain order on exact ties. Refit chosen constructor on all original training records. These are conditional head diagnostics: the inherited latent route was learned from the entire original training set, so the folds are not an unbiased whole-model generalization estimate. Score and retain the local329 initializer on the same folds as an external control; it does not select the new model.
